title: Subfamily Anomaloninae Viereck, 1918
content: The fauna of the subfamily Anomaloninae Viereck, 1918 in the Middle East includes 69 known species in 19 genera, of which, Agrypon Foerster, 1860 with 15 recorded species is the most species rich genus. Iranian Anomaloninae comprises 46 species in 13 genera, which is the most diverse fauna among the Middle Eastern countries.
